verdict.rationale: Relay's own docs say it issues Visa debit or credit cards to team members, supports up to 50 virtual or physical debit cards, and lets admins define roles and spend limits. A third-party review corroborates that physical cards exist by citing their per-card limits. Missing for 10: a support article on the card-issuance workflow, detail on which roles exist and what they control, and explicit confirmation that credit cards (not just debit) come in physical form.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can issue physical debit or credit cards to employees with defined roles

citations.quote: Issue Visa® debit³ or credit cards⁴, set spend limits, define roles, and track every transaction in real time.
Issue 50 virtual or physical Visa debit cards to your team
Issue debit and credit cards to team members.
Give team members and financial advisors secure, role-based banking access
For Relay's physical cards, there is a maximum daily card transaction limit of $7,000 and an ATM withdrawal limit of $1,000 per card.
